title: Tow Share on Financed and Covered Purchases — Trade-In Agreements
content:
A towing deduction under **Trade-In Agreements** carries a tow share set by how the buyer's purchase is carried.

### What decides the share?

How the purchase the trade is applied to is carried: whether it is paid through an active contract under **Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts**, and whether a contract under **KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts** is written on it.

| Purchase the trade is applied to | Tow share |
|---|---|
| Paid through an active Kestrel Auto Finance contract, KestrelCare service contract written on it | 0.8 |
| Paid through an active Kestrel Auto Finance contract, no KestrelCare service contract on it | 0.9 |
| Any other case | One (no reduction) |

### How does it act?

The share multiplies the towing deduction as a whole, once; the result is rounded to the nearest cent only at the end.

### Does an approved but not yet active finance contract count?

No. Only a Kestrel Auto Finance contract whose status is active counts.

### Worked example (hypothetical)

A towing deduction of $224.00 before the share, on a trade applied to a financed purchase carrying a KestrelCare contract: $224.00 multiplied by 0.8 is $179.20. Without the KestrelCare contract: $201.60.
